name: Takamine Rin
source:
Daughter of a wealthy family of the financial world and student council president.

Rin is a very proud girl and cares deeply for her sister Yuuna and her school mates.

Seven years ago she was drugged by Takashi but decided to not tell anyone. 
Since then she despises him and is very careful around him.
